notes: Logical capacities and requested hash layout bytes exclude allocator metadata and process RSS/footprint.
Dense owner correction is 64 bytes per DEX on this macOS arm64 ABI only; raw historical records are unchanged.
Node tables count fixed maps/locks, buckets/control alignment, node string objects and external characters separately.
Node instrumentation bytes are excluded. Largest single-table old+new bucket overlap is not a process peak.
Dense fixture fully materializes 60000 methods and 60000 fields; QQ has sparse generated descriptors.
Name indexes borrow raw string bytes. Field-use directories and allocation counts are unchanged by token packing.
Class-field contiguity is a census observation, not proof that every legal DEX preserves a proposed range representation.
